//: Dependency license policy for .github/scripts/license-check.mjs and .github/workflows/license-check.yml (haxtheweb/issues#3262). Same allow and review lists as haxtheweb/webcomponents.
allow: SPDX ids compatible with Apache-2.0. review: id prefixes a maintainer must look at (weak copyleft). Anything else fails, as do unknown licenses.
exceptions: packages a maintainer has accepted, keyed by purl without version, with the exact license expressions accepted. The PR gate skips them; the weekly sweep fails if their license changes.
axe-core and @axe-core/playwright (MPL-2.0) are the accessibility scanner in .github/a11y: test tooling run in CI, used unmodified, never part of what this repo publishes.
